name: codeledger
description: Deterministic context selection for AI coding agents. Scores every file across 10 signals, delivers a ranked bundle within a token budget, and exposes a live context cockpit so agents always read the right files first.

tools.name: query_ledger
tools.description: Search Golden Patterns and episodes from repo memory for a task

tools.name: get_active_context
tools.description: Return the current active context bundle to the agent

tools.name: record_interaction
tools.description: Write success/failure signals into the evidence buffer

tools.name: prompt_validate
tools.description: Score a task prompt against best practices before execution

tools.name: codeledger_replay
tools.description: Search retained terminal flows for prior execution patterns

tools.name: codeledger_recent_flows
tools.description: Retrieve recent retained operational execution history

tools.name: codeledger_flow_explain
tools.description: Explain why a specific flow was kept by the Context Sieve

tools.name: codeledger_reason
tools.description: Synthesis with pre-reasoning gating — FAST / GUIDED / FULL modes

tools.name: codeledger_system_map
tools.description: System topology — blast radius, component roles, invariants

tools.name: codeledger_context_pointers
tools.description: Bootstrap guidance — canonical docs and entry points for a scope

tools.name: codeledger_execution_prompt
tools.description: Generate a repo-aware Reality Loop execution prompt for a task

tools.name: panel_snapshot
tools.description: Full context cockpit snapshot: bundle, status, annotations, cert state

tools.name: panel_brief
tools.description: Focused markdown brief for the Explain, Learnings, or Next tab

tools.name: panel_handoff
tools.description: Scoped handoff: top files to inspect, risk notes, verification commands
